pipelines.name: Beta release

steps.name: Install dependencies
steps.run: bun ci

steps.name: Select beta version reserved by this run ID
steps.run: bun scripts/beta-release.ts >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Install dependencies
steps.run: bun ci

steps.name: Set beta package version in the runner
steps.run: bun scripts/beta-release.ts --apply

steps.name: Verify beta release policy and derive publish plan
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
RELEASE_PLAN="$(bun scripts/beta-release.ts --plan)"
DIST_TAG="$(jq -r '.distTag' <<< "$RELEASE_PLAN")"
echo "DIST_TAG=$DIST_TAG" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
echo "FINAL_PLAN=$RELEASE_PLAN" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
echo "dist-tag=$DIST_TAG" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "Selected npm dist-tag $DIST_TAG"
jq '.packages' <<< "$RELEASE_PLAN"

steps.name: Typecheck
steps.run: bun run typecheck

steps.name: Run tests
steps.run: bun test

steps.name: Build and fake-call every endpoint in every API snapshot
steps.run: bun run conformance:all

steps.name: Verify npm supports staged publishing (requires npm >= 11.15.0)
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
NPM_VERSION="$(npm --version)"
MINIMUM="11.15.0"
if [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$MINIMUM" "$NPM_VERSION" | sort -V | head -n1)" != "$MINIMUM" ]; then
  echo "::error::npm $NPM_VERSION is too old for staged publishing (need >= $MINIMUM)"
  exit 1
fi
echo "npm $NPM_VERSION"

steps.name: Prepare canonical and legacy npm packages
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
PACKAGE_ROOT="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.npm-packages"
bun scripts/npm-packages.ts "$PACKAGE_ROOT" "$RELEASE_SHA"
echo "PACKAGE_ROOT=$PACKAGE_ROOT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Verify both packed tarballs
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
for package in canonical legacy; do
  FILES="$(npm pack --dry-run --json --ignore-scripts "$PACKAGE_ROOT/$package" | jq -r '.[0].files[].path')"
  for required in LICENSE bin/langfuse.mjs dist/cli.js dist/contracts/catalog.json README.md; do
    if ! grep -qx "$required" <<< "$FILES"; then
      echo "::error::$required is missing from the $package npm tarball"
      exit 1
    fi
  done
done
test "$(jq -r '.name' "$PACKAGE_ROOT/canonical/package.json")" = "@langfuse/cli"
test "$(jq -r '.name' "$PACKAGE_ROOT/legacy/package.json")" = "langfuse-cli"
cmp README.md "$PACKAGE_ROOT/canonical/README.md"
cmp npm/legacy/README.md "$PACKAGE_ROOT/legacy/README.md"
diff -qr "$PACKAGE_ROOT/canonical/bin" "$PACKAGE_ROOT/legacy/bin"
diff -qr "$PACKAGE_ROOT/canonical/dist" "$PACKAGE_ROOT/legacy/dist"
echo "Both tarballs verified."

steps.name: Smoke-test the built CLI under Node and Bun
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
node bin/langfuse.mjs --version
bun bin/langfuse.mjs --help > /dev/null
echo "Smoke test passed."

steps.name: Pack canonical package for publishing
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/beta-release"
TARBALL="$(npm pack "$PACKAGE_ROOT/canonical" --ignore-scripts --json --pack-destination "$RUNNER_TEMP/beta-release" | jq -r '.[0].filename')"
mv "$RUNNER_TEMP/beta-release/$TARBALL" "$RUNNER_TEMP/beta-release/package.tgz"

steps.name: Report release plan
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
VERSION="$(jq -r '.version' <<< "$FINAL_PLAN")"
{
  echo "### Release plan"
  echo ""
  echo "Version: $VERSION"
  echo ""
  echo "npm dist-tag: $DIST_TAG"
  echo ""
  jq -r '.packages[] | "- \(.name): \(.status)"' <<< "$FINAL_PLAN"
  echo "- langfuse-cli: validated, publishing disabled"
} | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

steps.name: Install dependencies
steps.run: bun ci

steps.name: Set beta package version in the runner
steps.run: bun scripts/beta-release.ts --apply

steps.name: Set up Node (bundles the npm that performs the publish)
Verify npm supports staged publishing (requires npm >= 11.15.0)
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
NPM_VERSION="$(npm --version)"
MINIMUM="11.15.0"
if [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$MINIMUM" "$NPM_VERSION" | sort -V | head -n1)" != "$MINIMUM" ]; then
  echo "::error::npm $NPM_VERSION is too old for staged publishing (need >= $MINIMUM)"
  exit 1
fi
echo "npm $NPM_VERSION"

steps.name: Re-verify release policy immediately before publish
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
FINAL_PLAN="$(bun scripts/beta-release.ts --plan)"
FINAL_TAG="$(jq -r '.distTag' <<< "$FINAL_PLAN")"
if [ "$FINAL_TAG" != "$DIST_TAG" ]; then
  echo "::error::dist-tag changed between verification and publish ($DIST_TAG -> $FINAL_TAG)"
  exit 1
fi
echo "FINAL_PLAN=$FINAL_PLAN" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
jq '.packages' <<< "$FINAL_PLAN"

steps.name: Stage @langfuse/cli on npm
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
STATUS="$(jq -r '.packages.canonical.status' <<< "$FINAL_PLAN")"
VERSION="$(jq -r '.version' <<< "$FINAL_PLAN")"
if [ "$STATUS" = "already-published" ]; then
  echo "@langfuse/cli@$VERSION was already published from this release; skipping."
else
  npm stage publish "$RUNNER_TEMP/beta-release/package.tgz" --ignore-scripts --tag "$DIST_TAG"
fi

steps.name: Report staging result
steps.run:
VERSION="$(jq -r '.version' <<< "$FINAL_PLAN")"
echo "Beta $VERSION staged (or already published). Review @langfuse/cli in npm's Staged Packages tab and approve with 2FA. The stage ID is in the upload log." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

pipelines.name: Release

steps.name: Verify published GitHub release
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
RELEASE="$(gh release view "$TAG_NAME" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json tagName,isDraft,isPrerelease)"
jq -e '.tagName == env.TAG_NAME and .isDraft == false' <<< "$RELEASE"
echo "IS_PRERELEASE=$(jq -r '.isPrerelease' <<< "$RELEASE")" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Verify released commit is on main
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin main
if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD origin/main; then
  echo "::error::released commit is not on main"
  exit 1
fi
RELEASE_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
if [ "$GITHUB_REF" != "refs/tags/$TAG_NAME" ] || [ "$RELEASE_SHA" != "$GITHUB_SHA" ]; then
  echo "::error::release source must match the workflow ref and SHA for npm provenance"
  exit 1
fi
echo "RELEASE_SHA=$RELEASE_SHA" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
echo "Release commit: $RELEASE_SHA"
